classification.difficultyReason: Complete the scaffolded annual balance table by calculating 4% interest and carrying balances forward, then substitute the same values into the supplied formula. The table and substitution blanks guide the method.

content.prompt: $\$5000$ is invested for 3 years at 4% p.a. interest, compounded yearly. Fill in the table.

inlines.text: Each ending balance becomes the next starting balance. Interest = starting balance × 4%. Display amounts to cents and retain unrounded values in intermediate calculations.

children.label: a
children.prompt: Using the table, what is the balance at the end of year 3?

answer.worked: The ending balance in the year 3 row is $\$5624.32$.

inlines.text: Calculate the answer to part a using the future value formula. Give your answer to 2 decimal places.

answer.short: $\$5624.32$, the same value as part a. Substitution: $\$5000\times(1+0.04)^3$.
